why_realistic: _TYPE_RULES is joined to the frozen config enum cfg['machine_types'] BY KEY, exactly like the sourcehealth DEFAULT_SPECS rows that lib.py warns about ('rename one side only and the source silently becomes unknown, never ok'). Spelling the lane with an underscore in the rule table while the config keeps the hyphen makes the lane unreachable for every item, and the item falls through to the tool-saas default instead.
oracle:
"""Every machine-type lane the rule table defines must be reachable.

The rules table and the config enum are joined by key, so a lane spelled one way in code and
another way in config can never be emitted: the item quietly takes the tool-saas default and the
whole open-source-monetization category disappears from the archive without any error. Asserts what
classify RETURNS for an item that is unmistakably that lane."""
from classify import classify

CFG = {
    "tracks": [{"id": "dev-tools", "weight": 1.0, "enabled": True, "keywords": ["database"]}],
    "machine_types": ["tool-saas", "marketplace", "media", "service", "hardware",
                      "arbitrage", "oss-monetization"],
    "focus_topics": [],
    "exclude": [],
}

TITLE = "an open source database"
TEXT = "you can self-host it or buy a license"


def test_the_oss_monetization_lane_is_reachable():
    out = classify(TITLE, TEXT, CFG)
    assert "oss-monetization" in out["machine_type"], out


def test_it_did_not_silently_take_the_default_lane():
    out = classify(TITLE, TEXT, CFG)
    assert out["machine_type"] != ["tool-saas"], out


def test_emitted_types_stay_inside_the_frozen_config_enum():
    out = classify(TITLE, TEXT, CFG)
    assert set(out["machine_type"]) <= set(CFG["machine_types"]), out
